item_name: Rothco Swiss Military Canvas Shoulder Bag
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Swiss Military Canvas Shoulder Bag is constructed of heavyweight cotton canvas and features a vintage military inspired screened cross and numbering at the center of the storm flap.
description: Rothco’s Military Shoulder Bag is constructed of heavyweight cotton canvas for maximum durability. The shoulder strap on this canvas bag is fully adjustable with a full length of 54 ¼” and is made of cotton webbing material. This military shoulder bag features a fold over storm flap that securely closes with a metal revolving closure and vintage military inspired screened cross and numbering at the center of the storm flap. Measuring 9" X 4 ¼” X 9", the main compartment is perfect to store your essential items and gear. 2 Metal D-rings and plastic buttons are featured on the canvas shoulder bag as well.
